title: Ontic state recovery through prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.27139v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We encounter a system through its responses, yet its state concerns how the system is. Predicting further responses promises knowledge beyond what is immediately observed. What that knowledge tells us about the system's state depends on what we mean by a state in the first place. We give this notion a model-relative meaning: a state is the complete response profile over a specified query universe, and configurations agreeing on every query are regarded as the same state. From this perspective, a learned state is understood through the distinctions between these profiles that it retains. Prediction concerns selected observations; recovery concerns the profile as a whole. We examine their relationship through query ambiguity, state-space geometry, and the choice of prediction targets. translated_title: 通过预测恢复本体状态
translated_abstract: 我们通过系统的响应来接触一个系统，而其状态所关涉的是系统本身是怎样的。对更多响应的预测有望带来超越直接观测的知识。这些知识能告诉我们关于系统状态的什么，取决于我们最初如何定义“状态”。我们为这一概念赋予一种模型相对的含义：状态是在指定查询全域上的完整响应档案，并且在所有查询上都一致的配置被视为同一状态。从这一视角出发，一个被学习到的状态是通过它所保留的响应档案之间的区分来理解的。预测关注的是被挑选的观测，而恢复关注的是响应档案的整体。我们通过查询歧义性、状态空间几何结构以及预测目标的选择来考察二者的关系。具有已知响应规律的合成系统与神经记录为本研究提供了互补的研究场景。本文旨在阐明预测如何……
tldr: 本文将状态定义为指定查询全域上的完整响应档案，并从查询歧义性、状态空间几何和预测目标选择三个角度，结合合成系统与神经记录数据，考察“预测”与“本体状态恢复”之间的关系。
en_tdlr: This paper defines a state model-relatively as the complete response profile over a specified query universe, and examines the relationship between prediction and ontic state recovery through query ambiguity, state-space geometry, and prediction target choices, using synthetic systems and neural recordings.
